scope: Additive TH18 regular Goblin direct-parent and resource-priority baseline.
game_version: Goblins Farm reports client build 18.600.3. The frozen level-10 observation is retained separately; no consulted official update publishes a complete current Goblin table or pathing contract.

sources.title: Goblin
sources.limitations: The page reports L1-L10 hitpoints/DPS and identifies resource priority, x2 resource damage, ground-only target class, one-second cadence, melee range, housing and fast ground movement. It does not publish target tie-breaks, path reachability, attack/contact geometry, retarget timing, spell/trap interaction or fixed-tick ordering.

sources.title: Goblin
sources.limitations: The frozen level-10 observation supplies a traceable public table but has no immutable client build. It corroborates data only and cannot establish deterministic behavior chronology.

support.note: Core uses the immutable resource focus and x2 resource multiplier through the common targeting and damage paths; Headless, Viewer and RL call the same battle state.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source provides target equal-distance ties, exact path costs/reachability, retarget timing, attack wind-up/contact geometry, collision radius, spell stacking, trap interaction or fixed-tick ordering.
No consulted source provides a primary current L1-L10 table or verified visual scale/animation for Goblin.
The Core's shared resource-targeting rule is deterministic but is not asserted to reproduce undocumented client pathing or retarget boundaries.
conclusion: Goblin L1-L10 is executable as a source-bounded resource-priority direct-parent baseline through Core, Headless CLI, Viewer and RL. Its common x2 resource damage is tested; chronology, geometry, interactions and visual fidelity remain partial.
